cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

# ================================================================
# Unified resvg-bindings (library + icon compiler)
# ================================================================

set(RESVG_BINDINGS_DIR
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/tools/resvg-bindings"
)

set(RESVG_LIB_DIR
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/resvg-lib"
)

set(ICON_COMPILER_OUTPUT
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/IconData.h"
)

set(ICONS_DIR
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/icons"
)

# resvg_c.h is generated by the crate's build.rs (cbindgen). We pass an
# absolute, deterministic destination in the build tree via the
# RESVG_HEADER_OUT env var so build.rs writes it straight there — no
# source-tree copy, no staging step, no race with the C++ compile.
set(RESVG_HEADER_GEN "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/resvg_c.h")

file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${RESVG_LIB_DIR}")

# ================================================================
# Build resvg-bindings (library + compiler) with static CRT
# ================================================================

if(WIN32)
    set(RESVG_RUST_TARGET "x86_64-pc-windows-gnu")
    set(RESVG_CARGO_RELEASE_DIR
        "${RESVG_LIB_DIR}/cargo/${RESVG_RUST_TARGET}/release"
    )
    set(RESVG_DLL "${RESVG_CARGO_RELEASE_DIR}/resvg_c.dll")
    set(RESVG_IMPLIB "${RESVG_CARGO_RELEASE_DIR}/libresvg_c.dll.a")
    set(ICON_COMPILER_EXE "${RESVG_CARGO_RELEASE_DIR}/icon_compiler.exe")

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT
            ${RESVG_DLL}
            ${RESVG_IMPLIB}
            ${ICON_COMPILER_EXE}
            ${RESVG_HEADER_GEN}

        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env
            CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${RESVG_LIB_DIR}/cargo
            CARGO_BUILD_TARGET=${RESVG_RUST_TARGET}
            RESVG_HEADER_OUT=${RESVG_HEADER_GEN}
            "RUSTFLAGS=-C target-feature=+crt-static -C link-args=-static"
            cargo build --release --manifest-path ${RESVG_BINDINGS_DIR}/Cargo.toml

        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${RESVG_BINDINGS_DIR}
        COMMENT "Building resvg-bindings (library + compiler)"
        VERBATIM
    )

    add_custom_target(build_resvg_bindings
        DEPENDS
            ${RESVG_DLL}
            ${RESVG_IMPLIB}
            ${ICON_COMPILER_EXE}
            ${RESVG_HEADER_GEN}
    )

    add_library(resvg_c SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)
    set_target_properties(resvg_c PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${RESVG_DLL}"
        IMPORTED_IMPLIB "${RESVG_IMPLIB}"
    )

else()
    set(RESVG_CARGO_RELEASE_DIR
        "${RESVG_LIB_DIR}/cargo/release"
    )
    set(RESVG_SO "${RESVG_CARGO_RELEASE_DIR}/libresvg_c.so")
    set(ICON_COMPILER_EXE "${RESVG_CARGO_RELEASE_DIR}/icon_compiler")

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT
            ${RESVG_SO}
            ${ICON_COMPILER_EXE}
            ${RESVG_HEADER_GEN}

        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env
            CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${RESVG_LIB_DIR}/cargo
            RESVG_HEADER_OUT=${RESVG_HEADER_GEN}
            cargo build --release --manifest-path ${RESVG_BINDINGS_DIR}/Cargo.toml

        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${RESVG_BINDINGS_DIR}
        COMMENT "Building resvg-bindings (library + compiler)"
        VERBATIM
    )

    add_custom_target(build_resvg_bindings
        DEPENDS
            ${RESVG_SO}
            ${ICON_COMPILER_EXE}
            ${RESVG_HEADER_GEN}
    )

    add_library(resvg_c SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)
    set_target_properties(resvg_c PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${RESVG_SO}"
    )
endif()

add_dependencies(resvg_c build_resvg_bindings)

# ================================================================
# Icon compiler execution (generates IconData.h)
# ================================================================

# Glob every source SVG so the generation re-runs whenever an icon is ADDED,
# REMOVED or EDITED — not only when the compiler binary changes. CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
# makes CMake re-glob at build time, so a brand-new .svg is picked up without a
# manual re-configure. (Adding/removing a file still ideally wants a reconfigure,
# but CONFIGURE_DEPENDS triggers it automatically on the next build.)
file(GLOB_RECURSE ICON_SVG_FILES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${ICONS_DIR}/*.svg")

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${ICON_COMPILER_OUTPUT}

    COMMAND ${ICON_COMPILER_EXE}
        ${ICONS_DIR}
        ${ICON_COMPILER_OUTPUT}

    DEPENDS
        ${ICON_COMPILER_EXE}
        ${ICON_SVG_FILES}        # any SVG change → regenerate IconData.h

    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    COMMENT "Compiling icons to IconData.h"
    VERBATIM
)

# `generate_icon_data` is built as part of ALL, but is also a standalone target:
#   cmake --build <build-dir> --target generate_icon_data
# regenerates ONLY IconData.h (seconds), without relinking the whole app.
add_custom_target(generate_icon_data ALL
    DEPENDS ${ICON_COMPILER_OUTPUT}
)

# ================================================================
# VectorGraphics static library
# ================================================================

# Listing the generated headers as sources ties their producing custom
# commands into this target's dependency graph (so they are built first).
add_library(VectorGraphics STATIC
    src/IconManager.cpp
    editors/IconEditorWindow.cpp
    ${ICON_COMPILER_OUTPUT}
    ${RESVG_HEADER_GEN}
)

add_dependencies(VectorGraphics
    generate_icon_data
    build_resvg_bindings
)

# Belt-and-braces: pin the explicit object-level dependency so the
# IconManager.cpp compile waits for the generated header even under -j.
set_source_files_properties(src/IconManager.cpp PROPERTIES
    OBJECT_DEPENDS "${RESVG_HEADER_GEN}"
)

target_include_directories(VectorGraphics
    PUBLIC
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
        # build.rs writes resvg_c.h straight here (RESVG_HEADER_OUT).
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated
    PRIVATE
        ${IMGUI_DIR}
        ${IMGUI_DIR}/backends
)

target_link_libraries(VectorGraphics PUBLIC
    DesignSystem
    Vulkan::Vulkan
    resvg_c
)

# ================================================================
# Runtime DLL copy (Windows only)
# ================================================================

if(WIN32)
    add_custom_command(TARGET VectorGraphics POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "$<TARGET_PROPERTY:resvg_c,IMPORTED_LOCATION>"
            "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:VectorGraphics>/resvg_c.dll"
        COMMENT "Copying resvg_c.dll to VectorGraphics output"
    )
endif()
